servicesIndex.title: Services — CNC Milling, Turning, Grinding | RUDA Orodjarstvo
servicesIndex.description: CNC milling, turning, and grinding of high-precision components. Hard materials up to 65 HRC, solid carbide (WIDIA), 5-axis milling. Spodnja Idrija, Slovenia.
servicesIndex.heading: Services
servicesIndex.intro: Three core services from one workshop: CNC milling, turning, and precision grinding. RUDA Orodjarstvo specialises in hard materials and solid carbide (WIDIA).

milling.title: Milling (5-axis CNC, up to 65 HRC) — RUDA Orodjarstvo
milling.description: 5-axis CNC milling of all materials, including hard steels up to 65 HRC and solid carbide (WIDIA). Single parts, prototypes, and small to medium batches. Slovenia.
milling.lead: 5-axis CNC milling of all materials, including hardened tool steels up to 65 HRC and solid carbide (WIDIA). Single parts, prototypes, and small to medium batch production.
what: 5-axis milling of all types of materials
milling.materials: All standard tool steels (1.2080, 1.2363, 1.2379, 1.2767, K340), stainless steels, aluminium, copper, brass, hardened steel up to 65 HRC, and solid carbide (WIDIA). Tolerances are strictly matched to project requirements.
milling.applications: Stamping tools, injection moulds, forming tools, die-casting moulds, precision machine-building parts, micro-components for medicine and electronics, prototypes.

faq.q: What is the maximum hardness you can mill?
faq.a: Up to 65 HRC, including hardened tool steels and solid carbide (WIDIA).
Yes — for all materials, including hard materials and solid carbide.

faq.q: Can you produce single parts or only batches?
faq.a: Both — single parts, prototypes, and small to medium batches.
All standard tool steels, stainless steels, aluminium, solid carbide (WIDIA), and hardened steels up to 65 HRC.
Spodnja Idrija, Slovenia. We ship across the EU.

turning.title: Turning — CNC, all materials — RUDA Orodjarstvo
turning.description: CNC turning of all types of materials. Prototyping and small to medium batch production. High precision. Slovenia.
turning.lead: CNC turning of all types of materials. Prototypes and small to medium batches with high precision and repeatable accuracy.
what: Turning of all types of materials
turning.materials: Structural and stainless steels, tool steels, aluminium, copper, brass, plastics. Diameters from micro-dimensions to typical machine-building components.
turning.applications: Precision shafts, pins, bushings, punches, guides, components for stamping and injection-moulding tools, prototypes prior to series production.

faq.q: What precision do you achieve in turning?
faq.a: Tolerances are strictly matched to project requirements, including micrometre ranges.
Yes — from single parts to prototype runs.
All common structural, stainless, and tool steels, aluminium, copper, brass, and plastics.
Small to medium batch production, often combined with milling and grinding.

grinding.title: Grinding — surface and 4-axis profile — RUDA Orodjarstvo
grinding.description: Surface grinding and 4-axis profile grinding. Precision components for stamping and forming processes. Slovenia.
grinding.lead: Surface grinding and 4-axis profile grinding for precision components. High-quality finishes and demanding geometries.
grinding.materials: Hardened tool steels, solid carbide (WIDIA), stainless steels. Typically for stamping and forming tools where fine surface finishes and tight tolerances are required.
grinding.applications: Cutting plates for stamping, mould inserts, guides, tool profile sides, final finishing of hardened components.

faq.q: What surface quality do you achieve?
faq.a: Depending on requirements — we deliver final ground surfaces to the specified quality level.
Yes — 4-axis profile grinding for machining demanding geometries.
Hardened tool steels, solid carbide (WIDIA), and stainless steels.

faq.q: Do you combine grinding with other services?
faq.a: Yes — it often serves as the final finishing step after milling precision components.
